items.title: SimScale Engineering AI Moves Physics Simulation to the Exact Moment a Design Decision Gets Made, Inside Onshape
items.excerpt: SimScale launched an Engineering AI Agent inside Onshape that starts from raw CAD, proposes simulation setup and geometry cleanup, runs CFD, thermal, electromagnetic or FEA analyses, and interprets results. Engineers can inspect and override the agent's choices.

items.title: Neural Field Ensembles for Aerodynamic Surface Prediction: Winning Solution to the ONERA CRM Wall Distribution 2025 Challenge
items.category: AIによる設計・CFDサロゲート・航空宇宙
items.excerpt: A conditional neural-field ensemble predicts pressure and skin-friction distributions on the NASA CRM wing-body-pylon-nacelle configuration. On the hidden ONERA challenge test set, the authors report score 8.81 versus 8.64 for the strongest organizer baseline with roughly three orders fewer trainable parameters.

items.title: A Data Fusion Framework for Grounding Aerospace Surrogate Model via Experimental Wind-Tunnel Observations
items.category: AIによる設計・CFDサロゲート・実験データ融合
items.excerpt: A GeoTransolver surrogate trained on 2,300 high-fidelity CFD cases is corrected with wind-tunnel pressure-sensitive-paint measurements without changing pretrained surrogate parameters. The authors report held-out pressure agreement within 2.3–2.7% of measured Cp range.
items.query: "neural operator" surrogate CFD September 2026 arXiv

items.title: LLM-Aided Design for Manufacturing: A Multi-Agent System for Intent-Preserving Redesign of CAD for Improved Manufacturability
items.category: AIによる設計・CAD・Design for Manufacturing
items.excerpt: DFM-Redesign uses a multimodal LLM reviewer plus a CAD modifier that edits CadQuery programs through individually verified design transitions. A 46-part benchmark favors the verified modifier over single-agent baselines; full manufacturability and intent-preservation evaluation remains ongoing.
items.query: generative design optimization engineering AI September 2026

items.title: VisCAD: A Foundation Model Suite with Multimodal Industrial CAD Intelligence
items.excerpt: VisCAD targets part- and assembly-level industrial CAD from text, drawings, renders and photos. VisCAD-M1 is a 27B part-generation model; the authors report 0.5540 average on PubCADBench/RealCADBench and 0.5797 when reused as a test-time verifier.
items.query: generative design optimization engineering AI September 2026

items.title: CIT-CAD: Constraint Intent Tree-based CAD Code Generation and Verification
items.excerpt: CIT-CAD converts natural-language design intent into an explicit Constraint Intent Tree that guides CAD-code generation, extracts constraints from generated programs, and localizes mismatches for repair. The authors report larger gains on more complex multi-entity designs.
items.query: generative design optimization engineering AI September 2026

items.title: A Novel Multi-fidelity Surrogate for Turbomachinery Design Optimization
items.category: AIによる設計・最適化・ターボ機械
items.excerpt: The proposed multi-single-fidelity optimization combines a global multi-fidelity surrogate with local high-fidelity-only surrogates where low-fidelity data becomes misleading. It is tested on turbine profile and endwall film-cooling optimization using fine- and coarse-mesh CFD.

items.title: AI-Augmented Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)
items.excerpt: SEI's collection presents AI-augmented MBSE using SysML v2 and AADL. The approach combines AI assistants with language-aware toolchains, curated domain knowledge, repeatable workflows, and deterministic validation and analysis to keep models, analyses and documentation aligned.
